newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Ind considers share placement.
newsitem.headline: Allied Ind considers share placement.

text.p: Allied Industries International Ltd said on Friday that it was in talks to raise capital by way of a share placement.
"The company had preliminary discussions with independent third parties relating to the raising of capital through the placement of shares," Allied Industries said in a statement.
"Such discussions are still at a preliminary stage," it said. The company did not give any additional details.
The company shares, which rose HK$0.04, or 2.4 percent, on Thursday, gained HK$0.02 to HK$1.75 in early Friday trade.
